How to post your kit

Three posts and a newsletter section, about ten minutes. Early Bird pricing ends November 15, so the sooner you share, the more your code is worth to your network.

1. Save your images

Any device

  1. Tap or click an image in your kit to open it full size.
  2. Phone: press and hold the image, then choose Save to Photos (iPhone) or Download image (Android).
  3. Computer: right-click the image and choose Save image as.
  4. Want everything at once? Tap Download as a zip in your kit: all three images, your newsletter section, and a captions.txt file with the text for every channel.

2. Instagram post

Image 1080 × 1350 (4:5)

  1. Tap +, then Post, and choose your post image.
  2. Keep the full vertical crop (tap the crop icon if Instagram cuts it to a square).
  3. Back on the kit, tap Copy text and paste it as your caption.
  4. Tap Tag people, then Invite collaborator, and add @athena_international so the post also shows on ATHENA's profile.
  5. Tap Share.

3. Instagram Story

Image 1080 × 1920 (9:16)

  1. Tap +, then Story, and choose your Story image.
  2. On the kit, tap Copy link.
  3. In Instagram, tap the sticker icon, choose Link, and paste.
  4. Tap Customize sticker text and type Get your pass. Place the sticker over the empty blue space at the bottom.
  5. Add a Mention sticker with @athena_international, then share.

4. LinkedIn post

Image 1200 × 1500 (4:5)

  1. Tap Start a post, then the photo icon, and choose your LinkedIn image.
  2. On the kit, tap Copy text and paste it into the post. The link becomes clickable on its own.
  3. Type @ATHENA International anywhere in the text and pick the company page from the list.
  4. Tap Post.

5. Newsletter

Your own email list · 600 px section

  1. Scroll to Newsletter section at the end of your kit. Not a speaker or board member? Use the fill-in template.
  2. Gmail, Outlook, Substack, Beehiiv or a LinkedIn newsletter: tap Copy formatted and paste it into your draft.
  3. Mailchimp: drag a Code block into your email, tap Copy HTML code and paste. Constant Contact, Flodesk, HubSpot: same, in a Custom code / HTML block.
  4. Anything else? Tap Copy plain text, or Open full email to forward it as is.
  5. Send yourself a test first. The buttons and links already point to the ticket page with your code.

Two newsletter versions?

Speakers on the board

  1. You have a speaker version (your session) and a board version (your favorite quote).
  2. Pick the one that fits your list, or send one now and the other closer to January.

Your code works on General Admission and VIP passes. Mention it in comments and replies too, and repost your Story a week before November 15.
